Solidarity of Steel#361.dst: ¡Hay que darse prisa y no puedo pensar!
Solidarity of Steel#361.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#362.src: Pack something to help Aihan some form of a piece of and something to
Solidarity of Steel#362.dst: Guarda algo para ayudar a Aihan algún tipo de un trozo de y algo para

Solidarity of Steel#363.src: {u}, h- h- hurry! We don't have m- mu- much time!
Solidarity of Steel#363.dst: {u}, ¡d- d- date prisa! ¡No tenemos m- mu- mucho tiempo!
Solidarity of Steel#363.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#365.src: Where- where are you going? D-d-don't leave me here!
Solidarity of Steel#365.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#366.src: Did you get everything? Can we go?
Solidarity of Steel#366.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#367.src: Okay... No one's here yet. Let's go!
Solidarity of Steel#367.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#369.src: We're out of time, we have to get moving! Come on, come on!
Solidarity of Steel#369.dst: ¡Se acabó el tiempo, hay que moverse! ¡Vamos, vamos!
Solidarity of Steel#369.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#370.src: Up the ladder, into the tunnel! Go, go, go!
Solidarity of Steel#370.dst: ¡Por la escalera, al túnel! ¡Vamos, vamos, vamos!
Solidarity of Steel#370.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#371.src: Yuman... c- co- come on. Let's go.
Solidarity of Steel#371.dst: Yuman... v- va- vamos. Nos vamos.
Solidarity of Steel#371.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#374.src: Man... that was a really stupid thing for you to do. Like, astronomically stupid, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#374.dst: Tío... lo que has hecho ha sido una estupidez enorme. Vamos, astronómicamente estúpido, ¿sabes?
Solidarity of Steel#374.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#376.src: But I get it. I get it, y'know? If I didn't have to be a leader there, I'd've probably done the same thing!
Solidarity of Steel#376.dst: Pero lo entiendo. Lo entiendo, ¿sabes? ¡Si allí no hubiera tenido que mandar, seguramente habría hecho lo mismo!
Solidarity of Steel#376.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#377.src: Difference is, my bros can hold me back from that impulse. Guess I wasn't able to do that, here...
Solidarity of Steel#377.dst: La diferencia es que mis hermanos me frenan ese impulso. Parece que yo no pude hacer eso contigo...
Solidarity of Steel#377.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#378.src: Hate to disappoint 'em, y'know? Bit late now, though. What's done is done, can't take it back.
Solidarity of Steel#378.dst: Odio decepcionarlos, ¿sabes? Aunque ya es tarde. Lo hecho, hecho está, no hay vuelta atrás.
Solidarity of Steel#378.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#379.src: It'll be alright. Worse things've happened. Aihan's safe, that's all that matters! We'll deal with the rest as it comes.
Solidarity of Steel#379.dst: Saldrá bien. Han pasado cosas peores. ¡Aihan está a salvo, eso es lo que importa! Lo demás lo iremos viendo.
Solidarity of Steel#379.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#380.src: I- I should've... I should've l-lis- listened to you. But, s- s- seeing the way they- they were treating her... I was j- j- just so... angry. How dare th- they look down on p- p- people like that?!
Solidarity of Steel#380.dst: Y- yo debería... debería haberte h-he- hecho caso. Pero, a- a- al ver cómo la- la trataban... me puse t- t- tan... furioso. ¡¿Cómo se a- atreven a despreciar así a la g- g- gente?!
Solidarity of Steel#380.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#381.src: Yeah... I hear you. Hear you loud and clear. It's not right, is it? But that's what we're working to fix down here, man. Gotta do what little you can, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#381.dst: Ya... te entiendo. Alto y claro. No está bien, ¿verdad? Pero eso es lo que intentamos arreglar aquí abajo, tío. Hay que hacer lo poco que puedas, ¿no?
Solidarity of Steel#381.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#382.src: Let's get going. They'll be expecting us. Wouldn't want to keep 'em waiting.
Solidarity of Steel#382.dst: Vámonos. Nos estarán esperando. No los hagamos esperar.
Solidarity of Steel#382.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#383.src: ...We should f- f- follow them in.
Solidarity of Steel#383.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#384.src: Head back to the Steel Feather through the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#384.dst: Vuelve a la Pluma de Acero por el túnel en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#385.src: Report what happened to The Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#385.dst: Informa de lo ocurrido a la Pluma de Acero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#387.src: Would- w- would it be weird to say it's a r- r- relief to find out he has a ser- a- a serious side to him?
Solidarity of Steel#387.dst: ¿S- se- sería raro decir que es un a- a- alivio saber que tiene un lado s- se- serio?
Solidarity of Steel#387.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#388.src: Not- n- not that this is how I'd have w- w- wanted to find out...
Solidarity of Steel#388.dst: N- n- no es que quisiera e- en- enterarme así...
Solidarity of Steel#388.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#390.src: Jiro and I got her settled. Quill's giving her the rundown as we speak.
Solidarity of Steel#390.dst: Jiro y yo la hemos instalado. Quill le está explicando todo ahora mismo.
Solidarity of Steel#390.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#391.src: You should... probably avoid Jiro for now, yeah? He's not exactly... happy.
Solidarity of Steel#391.dst: Deberías... evitar a Jiro por ahora, ¿vale? No está precisamente... contento.
Solidarity of Steel#391.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#392.src: Right... Got it. So- s- so... how does it wor- work now? Should we re- record this mission s- somewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#392.dst: Vale... Entendido. E- en- entonces... ¿cómo fun- funciona ahora? ¿Hay que a- anotar esta misión en a- algún sitio?
Solidarity of Steel#392.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#393.src: Yep, yep! Normally I'd go to Quill, but he's busy. Let's see if we can find Yusanu first- he'll... understand. Probably. More than Yulie, at least. I trust him to keep it quiet for now, at least... y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#393.dst: ¡Sí, sí! Normalmente iría a Quill, pero está ocupado. Busquemos antes a Yusanu- él... lo entenderá. Seguramente. Al menos más que Yulie. Me fío de que se lo calle por ahora, al menos... ¿sabes?
Solidarity of Steel#393.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#395.src: Yuman, I swear. Yusanu should know better than to let you take the lead on these sorts of things! What were you thinking?
Solidarity of Steel#395.dst: Yuman, te lo juro. ¡Yusanu debería saber que no hay que dejarte al mando en estas cosas! ¿En qué pensabas?
Solidarity of Steel#395.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#396.src: Woah, woah, woah! That's a lot of accusations out of nowhere, bro! What gives?
Solidarity of Steel#396.dst: ¡Eh, eh, eh! ¡Cuántas acusaciones de la nada, tío! ¿Qué pasa?
Solidarity of Steel#396.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#397.src: What gives? You know what gives- a whole squadron of housing enforcers turns up dead on the job, and you expect that to go over quietly?
Solidarity of Steel#397.dst: ¿Que qué pasa? Sabes muy bien qué pasa- todo un escuadrón de agentes de vivienda aparece muerto en servicio, ¿y esperas que eso pase desapercibido?
Solidarity of Steel#397.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#398.src: Ahhh. That. Well, you know how it is. Things happen, right?
Solidarity of Steel#398.dst: Ahhh. Eso. Bueno, ya sabes cómo va. Pasan cosas, ¿no?
Solidarity of Steel#398.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#399.src: You-... at least pretend to take this seriously, would you? Of all people, you should know what this is going to lead to.
Solidarity of Steel#399.dst: Tú-... al menos finge que te lo tomas en serio, ¿quieres? Precisamente tú deberías saber adónde lleva esto.
Solidarity of Steel#399.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#400.src: It- it was- was- it wasn't his f- f- fault, I-
Solidarity of Steel#400.dst: N- no fue- fue- no fue c- c- culpa suya, yo-
Solidarity of Steel#400.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#401.src: Hey, princess, it's alright. Don't need you to cover for me, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#401.dst: Eh, princesa, tranquilo. No hace falta que me cubras, ¿vale?
Solidarity of Steel#401.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#402.src: So what's the plan then, Yulie? Meeting to talk about it, as always?
Solidarity of Steel#402.dst: ¿Y cuál es el plan, Yulie? ¿Reunión para hablarlo, como siempre?
Solidarity of Steel#402.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#403.src: Sigh... as soon as Quill gets Aihan sorted, yes. It shouldn't take long, so everyone's gathered in advance.
Solidarity of Steel#403.dst: Suspiro... sí, en cuanto Quill acabe con Aihan. No debería tardar, así que todos se han reunido ya.
Solidarity of Steel#403.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#405.src: Hey! What happened out there? Everyone's acting weird about it.
Solidarity of Steel#405.dst: ¡Eh! ¿Qué pasó ahí fuera? Todos están raros con el tema.
Solidarity of Steel#405.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#406.src: We ended up f- fight- fighting some soldiers to save the w- w- the woman we went there for...
Solidarity of Steel#406.dst: Acabamos pe- pele- peleando con unos soldados para salvar a la m- m- a la mujer a la que íbamos...
Solidarity of Steel#406.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#407.src: Huh. Is that all? I thought it'd be way worse.
Solidarity of Steel#407.dst: Vaya. ¿Solo eso? Pensaba que sería mucho peor.
Solidarity of Steel#407.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#408.src: Yeah... they- th- they're worried about it dr- draw- drawing attention...
Solidarity of Steel#408.dst: Ya... es- e- están preocupados por si lla- llama- llama la atención...
Solidarity of Steel#408.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#410.src: Still helping out in the kitchen, preparing for dinner! Worry not, I will catch her up once the meeting concludes.
Solidarity of Steel#410.dst: ¡Sigue echando una mano en la cocina con la cena! No temáis, la pondré al día cuando acabe la reunión.
Solidarity of Steel#410.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#411.src: Ah, hello everybody. Apologies for the delay.
Solidarity of Steel#411.dst: Ah, hola a todos. Disculpad la tardanza.
Solidarity of Steel#411.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#413.src: She hasn't quite decided yet, but she has agreed to stay the night. She's in a bad state of mind, the poor woman. Some rest will do her good.
Solidarity of Steel#413.dst: Aún no lo ha decidido del todo, pero ha aceptado pasar la noche. Está en muy mal estado de ánimo, la pobre. Descansar le vendrá bien.
Solidarity of Steel#413.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#414.src: But that leads us well to the reason this meeting was called. The retrieval process went... poorly, I take it?
Solidarity of Steel#414.dst: Pero eso nos lleva al motivo de esta reunión. El rescate salió... mal, ¿me equivoco?
Solidarity of Steel#414.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#415.src: Poorly is an understatement. The military is on high alert now! Everyone entering or leaving {p} this evening was questioned- if I hadn't used our tunnel, I'd still be stuck in line there!
Solidarity of Steel#415.dst: Mal se queda corto. ¡El ejército está en alerta máxima! Esta tarde han interrogado a todo el que entraba o salía de {p}- ¡si no llego a usar nuestro túnel, seguiría en la cola!
Solidarity of Steel#415.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#416.src: This is an unmitigated disaster. Yuman, what do you have to say for yourself? You should know better by now, we need to-
Solidarity of Steel#416.dst: Esto es un desastre absoluto. Yuman, ¿qué tienes que decir en tu defensa? A estas alturas deberías saberlo, necesitamos-
Solidarity of Steel#416.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#417.src: H- hey! It- it- it's not- it's n- not his f- f- fault! I'm the- the one who-
Solidarity of Steel#417.dst: ¡E- eh! N- n- no es- ¡n- no es c- c- culpa suya! Fui y- yo quien-
Solidarity of Steel#417.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#418.src: Nah, the blame falls on me. I was the leader, so anything that happened is my responsibility. I should've... been more firm about it.
Solidarity of Steel#418.dst: No, la culpa es mía. Yo era el líder, así que todo lo que pasó es responsabilidad mía. Debería haber... sido más firme.
Solidarity of Steel#418.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#419.src: None of this would have happened if I'd been there... damn it. The timing couldn't have been worse. This is all my-
Solidarity of Steel#419.dst: Nada de esto habría pasado si yo hubiera estado allí... maldita sea. Peor momento imposible. Todo esto es culpa-
Solidarity of Steel#419.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#420.src: Okay, that's enough. You're all acting stupid! Who cares whose fault it was? Either way, it already happened, so let's figure out what we're going to do about it.
Solidarity of Steel#420.dst: Vale, ya basta. ¡Os estáis comportando como tontos! ¿A quién le importa de quién fue la culpa? Ya ha pasado, así que pensemos qué vamos a hacer.
Solidarity of Steel#420.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#422.src: And I'm not done! You're all acting like it's the end of the world that some soldiers are dead. So what? Soldiers die all the time.
Solidarity of Steel#422.dst: ¡Y no he terminado! Actuáis como si fuera el fin del mundo que hayan muerto unos soldados. ¿Y qué? Los soldados mueren a todas horas.
Solidarity of Steel#422.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#423.src: They don't die like this, though. We don't have the luxury of being able to wave off the crown's attention! If they find out what we're doing down here, we're done for.
Solidarity of Steel#423.dst: Pero no mueren así. ¡No podemos permitirnos espantar la atención de la Corona como si nada! Si descubren lo que hacemos aquí abajo, estamos acabados.
Solidarity of Steel#423.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#424.src: But they haven't found out yet, have they? You have options still. For example- you're on the detective force! If suspicions arise, couldn't you just lead them elsewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#424.dst: Pero aún no lo han descubierto, ¿no? Todavía tenéis opciones. Por ejemplo- ¡tú estás en el cuerpo de detectives! Si surgen sospechas, ¿no podrías desviarlas?
Solidarity of Steel#424.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#425.src: Besides. If staying hidden means having to look away as innocent people get harmed- what kind of a resistance does that make you? What's the point of any of it?
Solidarity of Steel#425.dst: Además. Si esconderse significa mirar hacia otro lado mientras hacen daño a inocentes- ¿qué clase de resistencia sois? ¿Qué sentido tiene todo esto?
Solidarity of Steel#425.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#426.src: Rex... take care with your words. Don't say anything you'll-
Solidarity of Steel#426.dst: Rex... mide tus palabras. No digas nada de lo que vayas a-
Solidarity of Steel#426.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#427.src: What's the POINT?! The POINT is all the people we ALREADY have down here who we need to protect! Quill, please, back me up here.
Solidarity of Steel#427.dst: ¡¿Qué SENTIDO?! ¡El SENTIDO es toda la gente que YA tenemos aquí abajo y a la que hay que proteger! Quill, por favor, apóyame.
Solidarity of Steel#427.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#428.src: ... No, Yulie, Rex has a point. Even if it was phrased harshly... we have been rather passive in our battle thus far. We've let people get hurt, even if only for the sake of our safety.
Solidarity of Steel#428.dst: ... No, Yulie, Rex tiene razón. Aunque lo diga con dureza... hasta ahora hemos sido pasivos en esta lucha. Hemos dejado que hirieran a otros, aunque fuera por nuestra seguridad.
Solidarity of Steel#428.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#429.src: We have had our reasons... and we have done good work, to the best of our ability. But if we are afraid to act, how will anything ever change for the better?
Solidarity of Steel#429.dst: Hemos tenido nuestras razones... y hemos hecho un buen trabajo, dentro de nuestras posibilidades. Pero si tenemos miedo de actuar, ¿cómo va a mejorar algo?
Solidarity of Steel#429.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#431.src: You are not wrong to feel frustration, Yulie. I, too, wish this had been handled with more care... but something like this was bound to happen eventually. We will survive this, as we have survived other hardships before.
Solidarity of Steel#431.dst: No te falta razón al sentir frustración, Yulie. Yo también desearía que se hubiera llevado con más cuidado... pero algo así tenía que pasar tarde o temprano. Sobreviviremos a esto, como hemos sobrevivido a otras penurias.
Solidarity of Steel#431.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#433.src: ...But let's lighten the mood a little! Dinner should almost be ready. Yuman, you told me earlier today you were working on a new song. Would you still like to perform it tonight?
Solidarity of Steel#433.dst: ...¡Pero animemos un poco el ambiente! La cena estará casi lista. Yuman, hoy me has dicho que estabas con una canción nueva. ¿Sigues queriendo tocarla esta noche?
Solidarity of Steel#433.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#434.src: Huh? Oh, yeah, yeah man! I can do that, for sure.
Solidarity of Steel#434.dst: ¿Eh? ¡Ah, sí, sí, tío! Claro que puedo.
Solidarity of Steel#434.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#435.src: Ahem. Before we depart, if I may- while we are all gathered here, I believe it could be beneficial to lay out some relevant information.
Solidarity of Steel#435.dst: Ejem. Antes de irnos, si se me permite- ya que estamos todos reunidos, creo que sería útil exponer cierta información relevante.
Solidarity of Steel#435.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#436.src: Most of us are new to the Roughworks, so getting to know the lay of the land could help.
Solidarity of Steel#436.dst: La mayoría somos nuevos en Roughworks, así que conocer el terreno podría ayudar.
Solidarity of Steel#436.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#437.src: Right, of course. I'd been meaning to suggest something similar earlier, before... this situation came up.
Solidarity of Steel#437.dst: Sí, claro. Pensaba proponer algo parecido antes, hasta que... surgió esta situación.
Solidarity of Steel#437.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#438.src: Certainly, we could do that! What would you like to know?
Solidarity of Steel#438.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#439.src: Ah, yes. Her name is Soosu. It's hard to say much about her... she's rather reclusive, staying cooped up in her mansion, working away.
Solidarity of Steel#439.dst: Ah, sí. Se llama Soosu. Poco se puede decir de ella... es bastante solitaria, encerrada en su mansión, trabajando sin parar.
Solidarity of Steel#439.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#440.src: She's the opposite of Zhiraok, in that way. Ideally, we'll avoid drawing her attention. We'll have plenty to worry about already without adding her to the list.
Solidarity of Steel#440.dst: En eso es lo contrario de Zhiraok. Lo ideal sería no llamar su atención. Ya tendremos bastantes preocupaciones sin añadirla a la lista.
Solidarity of Steel#440.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#441.src: That'd be for the best, yeah. She's... kind of a genius. She singlehandedly brought forth the Industrial Age, over a century ago! Most of the machinery you see in Fruma probably traces its origin back to her in some way.
Solidarity of Steel#441.dst: Sí, sería lo mejor. Es... una especie de genio. ¡Ella sola trajo la Era Industrial hace más de un siglo! Casi toda la maquinaria que veis en Fruma seguramente tenga su origen en ella de algún modo.
Solidarity of Steel#441.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#442.src: Ha! Yeah, yeah, figures you'd know all that, bro. Nerd.
Solidarity of Steel#442.dst: ¡Ja! Sí, sí, cómo no ibas a saber todo eso, tío. Empollón.
Solidarity of Steel#442.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#443.src: Wh- that's just written history, Yuman. If you're going to make fun of me, at least do it right.
Solidarity of Steel#443.dst: Q- eso es historia escrita, Yuman. Si vas a burlarte de mí, hazlo bien al menos.
Solidarity of Steel#443.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#444.src: How about her blessing? If we do run into her, we'll want to know what to watch out for.
Solidarity of Steel#444.dst: ¿Y su bendición? Si nos topamos con ella, querremos saber de qué cuidarnos.
Solidarity of Steel#444.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#445.src: I don't know the specifics... but what I do know is that it allows her to mold matter at will. To what extent, or with what limits... hard to say. Still, that uncertainty is dangerous. Be careful.
Solidarity of Steel#445.dst: No sé los detalles... pero sí sé que le permite moldear la materia a voluntad. Hasta qué punto, o con qué límites... difícil decirlo. Aun así, esa duda es peligrosa. Cuidado.
Solidarity of Steel#445.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#446.src: Very well! Then let us adjourn for dinner.
Solidarity of Steel#446.dst: ¡Muy bien! Entonces levantamos la sesión para cenar.
Solidarity of Steel#446.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#447.src: Speak to Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and watch Yuman's performance.
Solidarity of Steel#447.dst: Habla con Sui en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y mira la actuación de Yuman.

Solidarity of Steel#448.src: Yuman's performance is about to start. You should grab a bite from Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#448.dst: La actuación de Yuman está a punto de empezar. ¡Pilla algo de comer con Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#448.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#449.src: Oh, {u}! I feel like I've barely seen you around here...
Solidarity of Steel#449.dst: ¡Ah, {u}! Siento que apenas te he visto por aquí...
Solidarity of Steel#449.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#450.src: I, um... Mora told me about what happened. On your mission. I'm... glad you were able to help that woman.
Solidarity of Steel#450.dst: Yo, eh... Mora me contó lo que pasó. En vuestra misión. Me... alegra que pudierais ayudar a esa mujer.
Solidarity of Steel#450.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#451.src: I, ha, kind of wish I could've been there, to help. Though, I don't... really know what I could have done, there.
Solidarity of Steel#451.dst: Yo, ja, ojalá hubiera podido estar allí, para ayudar. Aunque no... sé muy bien qué habría podido hacer.
Solidarity of Steel#451.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#452.src: S-so maybe it's a good thing! That I've been, um, busy, cooking. For the Steel Feather. There's, ha, a lot of people here!
Solidarity of Steel#452.dst: A-así que quizá sea bueno. Que haya estado, eh, ocupada, cocinando. Para la Pluma de Acero. ¡Hay, ja, muchísima gente aquí!
Solidarity of Steel#452.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#453.src: But I've been learning new recipes, and getting to know new people! Oh, right, you're probably here for, um, the food. Here! Please have some.
Solidarity of Steel#453.dst: ¡Pero estoy aprendiendo recetas nuevas y conociendo gente nueva! Ah, claro, habrás venido por, eh, la comida. ¡Toma! Sírvete.
Solidarity of Steel#453.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#454.src: ...oh, hi! Are you here for some food?
Solidarity of Steel#454.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#455.src: Ah, n-no, I- well, yes, I'd love some food, but I'm here to- to thank {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#455.dst: Ah, n-no, yo- bueno, sí, me encantaría comer algo, pero vengo a- a dar las gracias a {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#455.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#456.src: Don't- don't sell yourself short! I don't... f-fully understand yet, but, fighting the guards like... like that is dangerous, and- and I know why some people wouldn't want to...
Solidarity of Steel#456.dst: ¡No- no te quites mérito! Aún no... lo e-entiendo del todo, pero pelear con los guardias así... así es peligroso, y- y sé por qué algunos no querrían...
Solidarity of Steel#456.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#458.src: We- no, no, no, this- this won't work, I can't- you need to pack different things, I can't go with- with this, pleas
Solidarity of Steel#458.dst: No- no, no, no, esto- esto no vale, no puedo- tienes que llevar otras cosas, no puedo ir con- con esto, por fav

Solidarity of Steel#459.src: There's an inscription, but it's written in a language you can't understand.
Solidarity of Steel#459.dst: Hay una inscripción, pero está escrita en un idioma que no entiendes.

Solidarity of Steel#460.src: It's the poster you stuck on advertising the Pishlas Hot Springs.
Solidarity of Steel#460.dst: Es el cartel que pegaste anunciando las Termas de Pishlas.

Solidarity of Steel#461.src: But you did anyway, and- and- and it means a lot.
Solidarity of Steel#461.dst: Pero lo hicisteis igualmente, y- y- y significa mucho.
Solidarity of Steel#461.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#462.src: It, um, sounds like it was a really bad situation. So I'm glad you got out alright.
Solidarity of Steel#462.dst: Suena, eh, a que fue una situación muy fea. Así que me alegro de que salierais bien.
Solidarity of Steel#462.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#463.src: H-ha... yes. They've been... p-pushy before, but they've never been this- this- this, ah, violent.
Solidarity of Steel#463.dst: J-ja... sí. Antes ya se p-ponían pesados, pero nunca habían sido tan- tan- tan, ah, violentos.
Solidarity of Steel#463.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#464.src: Y-yes, I am. It's... new, and- and different, but everyone here has been so kind, and...
Solidarity of Steel#464.dst: S-sí, lo estoy. Es... nuevo, y- y distinto, pero aquí todo el mundo ha sido amabilísimo, y...
Solidarity of Steel#464.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#465.src: It's a little- a little strange... It almost feels like- like- like I don't deserve it! Because, I- I- I haven't... w-worked for it.
Solidarity of Steel#465.dst: Es un poco- un poco raro... ¡Casi siento que- que- que no me lo merezco! Porque, y-y-yo no... me lo he g-ganado.
Solidarity of Steel#465.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#466.src: Um... I don't really, know, what it's like to live here... but where I'm from, people help each other. You shouldn't have to earn the right to live.
Solidarity of Steel#466.dst: Eh... No sé muy, bien, cómo es vivir aquí... pero de donde vengo, la gente se ayuda. No deberías tener que ganarte el derecho a vivir.
Solidarity of Steel#466.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#467.src: Y-you must be from a much n-nicer place than- than here.
Solidarity of Steel#467.dst: T-tú debes de venir de un sitio mucho m-mejor que- que este.
Solidarity of Steel#467.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#468.src: Ha... it's k-kind of ridiculous, looking back. Stupid- s-stupid quotas... ouch...
Solidarity of Steel#468.dst: Ja... v-visto ahora, es hasta ridículo. Malditas- m-malditas cuotas... ay...
Solidarity of Steel#468.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#469.src: You want to know my story?

Solidarity of Steel#471.src: Oh, it- it's nothing. Just, heavy m-machinery. Hurt my shoulder when- when I went in. It- it's r-really my fault, I, I, I sh-should have been m-more careful...
Solidarity of Steel#471.dst: Ah, no- no es nada. Solo, m-maquinaria pesada. Me hice daño en el hombro al- al entrar. Es- es c-culpa mía, yo, yo, yo d-debía haber tenido m-más cuidado...
Solidarity of Steel#471.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#472.src: Um... I- I can, ha, I can help you.
Solidarity of Steel#472.dst: Eh... Yo- yo puedo, ja, puedo ayudarte.
Solidarity of Steel#472.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#474.src: Just... sigh. Follow me, and- and trust me.
Solidarity of Steel#474.dst: Solo... suspiro. Sígueme y- y confía en mí.
Solidarity of Steel#474.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#477.src: H-hey! I- I only have this shirt, I c- I can't- I-
Solidarity of Steel#477.dst: ¡E-eh! S- solo tengo esta camisa, n- no puedo- yo-
Solidarity of Steel#477.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#480.src: How did- how did you do that?
Solidarity of Steel#480.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#483.src: I-... th-thank you. I didn't... I didn't know cursed ones could be- could be nice.
Solidarity of Steel#483.dst: Yo-... g-gracias. No sabía... no sabía que los malditos pudieran ser- ser amables.
Solidarity of Steel#483.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#484.src: Um... I sh-should go. Thank you for- for the food, and- and- and for... healing my shoulder. I- I really appreciate it.
Solidarity of Steel#484.dst: Eh... D-debería irme. Gracias por- por la comida, y- y- y por... curarme el hombro. Te- te lo agradezco de verdad.
Solidarity of Steel#484.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#487.src: It's fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#487.dst: No pasa nada. Me lo esperaba. Me... alegra haber podido ayudar.
Solidarity of Steel#487.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#488.src: I- I guess so! Ha... at least she, um, wasn't scared. Just... nervous.
Solidarity of Steel#488.dst: ¡S- supongo que sí! Ja... al menos no, eh, se asustó. Solo... estaba nerviosa.
Solidarity of Steel#488.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#489.src: I'll, um, catch up with the rest of you, later.
Solidarity of Steel#489.dst: Yo, eh, me reúno con vosotros, luego.
Solidarity of Steel#489.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#490.src: Go join the others. Uh, I'll join you in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#490.dst: Ve con los demás. Eh, yo voy en un rato.
Solidarity of Steel#490.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#491.src: {u}, it's nice of you to join us. Have you had dinner yet?
Solidarity of Steel#491.dst: {u}, qué bien que te unas. ¿Ya has cenado?
Solidarity of Steel#491.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#492.src: It's good, isn't it? Quill tells me she's managed to fit right in with the other cooks here.
Solidarity of Steel#492.dst: Está buena, ¿verdad? Quill me dice que ha encajado perfectamente con los demás cocineros.
Solidarity of Steel#492.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#493.src: So, {u}, are you also w- wait- waiting for Yuman's performance?
Solidarity of Steel#493.dst: Y bien, {u}, ¿tú también es- esp- esperas la actuación de Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#493.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#494.src: I have heard great things about his musical talents! Though, ah, I have also heard this his variety, ah, leaves something to be desired.
Solidarity of Steel#494.dst: ¡He oído maravillas de su talento musical! Aunque, ah, también he oído que su variedad, ah, deja algo que desear.
Solidarity of Steel#494.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#495.src: Then worry not, for you have been reminded just now, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#495.dst: Pues no te preocupes, que acaban de recordártelo, ¡jojo!
Solidarity of Steel#495.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#496.src: Hey, maybe he's written a song about you, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#496.dst: ¡Oye, quizá haya escrito una canción sobre ti, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#496.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#497.src: Wh- wh- what?! R- Rex, no h- he-... that's n- not-... wh- why would he ev- even-
Solidarity of Steel#497.dst: ¡¿Q- q- qué?! R- Rex, no, é- él-... eso n- no-... p- por qué iba s- siquiera-
Solidarity of Steel#497.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#498.src: Ha! Relax, relax, I'm just teasing ya.
Solidarity of Steel#498.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#499.src: Ahem... Attention, attention! Everyone, gather around!
Solidarity of Steel#499.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#500.src: I am heartened to see so many of you joining us for dinner today. It feels as though it has been a while since we've had such a large attendance!
Solidarity of Steel#500.dst: Me reconforta ver a tantos de vosotros en la cena de hoy. ¡Parece que hacía tiempo que no teníamos tanta asistencia!
Solidarity of Steel#500.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#501.src: There is of course news to deliver... but first! We begin by thanking our cooks for the meal.
Solidarity of Steel#501.dst: Por supuesto hay noticias que dar... ¡pero antes! Empecemos dando las gracias a nuestros cocineros por la comida.
Solidarity of Steel#501.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#502.src: We're all familiar with Fletch's talents, but dinner wouldn't have been possible without the help of one of our new arrivals: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#502.dst: Todos conocemos el talento de Fletch, pero la cena no habría sido posible sin la ayuda de una recién llegada: ¡Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#502.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#503.src: Oh...! It, ha, it- um. It was nothing. T'was my pleasure! To- to help.
Solidarity of Steel#503.dst: ¡Ah...! Es, ja, es- eh. No fue nada. ¡Fue un placer! A- ayudar.
Solidarity of Steel#503.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#504.src: No need to be shy, my dear!
Solidarity of Steel#504.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#505.src: Dinner aside, let's get to the announcements!
Solidarity of Steel#505.dst: Dejando la cena, ¡vamos con los anuncios!
Solidarity of Steel#505.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#506.src: Today, we have had not one, but seven new arrivals! In addition to Sui, please welcome Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u}, and Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#506.dst: ¡Hoy no ha llegado uno, sino siete recién llegados! ¡Además de Sui, dad la bienvenida a Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u} y Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#506.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#507.src: Now, I'm certain news has spread of our... altercation, shall we say, with the crown's military. I assure you, all is under control! The Steel Feather remains secure and hidden.
Solidarity of Steel#507.dst: Sin duda ya habrá corrido la voz de nuestro... altercado, digamos, con el ejército de la Corona. ¡Os aseguro que todo está bajo control! La Pluma de Acero sigue segura y oculta.
Solidarity of Steel#507.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#508.src: It does mean expeditions out of the station will be at higher risk for a time. We will have updated guidelines available in the morning for those of you who volunteer.
Solidarity of Steel#508.dst: Eso sí, durante un tiempo las salidas de la estación serán más arriesgadas. Mañana por la mañana habrá instrucciones actualizadas para quienes se ofrezcan voluntarios.
Solidarity of Steel#508.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#509.src: But in lighter news, we have restocked candy bars and sodas at the ticket shops! Make sure to trade for some before they run out - remember the rules, one of each per person.
Solidarity of Steel#509.dst: Pero en noticias más alegres, ¡hemos repuesto chocolatinas y refrescos en las taquillas! Cambiadlas antes de que se acaben - recordad la norma: una de cada por persona.
Solidarity of Steel#509.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#510.src: Well then! Barring any surprises at this very moment, that is all for today's report. As he has volunteered himself today, I will hand over the stage to Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#510.dst: ¡Pues bien! Salvo sorpresas de última hora, eso es todo por el informe de hoy. Como hoy se ha ofrecido voluntario, le cedo el escenario a Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#510.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#511.src: Heeeeeelllllooooo people of the Steel Feather!
Solidarity of Steel#511.dst: ¡Hoooolaaaaa, gente de la Pluma de Acero!
Solidarity of Steel#511.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#512.src: Good to see you all as always- ey, Taio, lookin' good! Mei, love what you've done with the hair! Jin, my man!
Solidarity of Steel#512.dst: Un placer veros como siempre- ¡ey, Taio, qué buen aspecto! Mei, ¡me encanta tu pelo nuevo! ¡Jin, tío!
Solidarity of Steel#512.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#513.src: Ah... I guess I can introduce my song. It's a new one! You guys won't be able to tease me for being an artist with only one song anymore, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#513.dst: Ah... Supongo que puedo presentar mi canción. ¡Es nueva! ¡Ya no podréis picarme por ser un artista de una sola canción, jaja!
Solidarity of Steel#513.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#514.src: I've been working on this one for a while. Never could find a way to end it, though... 'till now, that is. Finally managed to find some inspiration.
Solidarity of Steel#514.dst: Llevo un tiempo trabajando en ella. Aunque nunca daba con el final... hasta ahora. Por fin he encontrado algo de inspiración.
Solidarity of Steel#514.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#515.src: Well, enough talking from me. Here it goes!
Solidarity of Steel#515.dst: Bueno, ya he hablado bastante. ¡Allá va!
Solidarity of Steel#515.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#517.src: Hm hm hm! Look who it is!
Solidarity of Steel#517.speaker: ??? (Sovereign Soosu)

Solidarity of Steel#520.src: Happy to see you again, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#520.dst: Me alegra volver a verte, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#520.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#522.src: You need to subtract some of this security. It shouldn't need to take twenty minutes to get through just the gate. We need to talk, an hour ago.
Solidarity of Steel#522.dst: Tienes que restar algo de esta seguridad. No debería costar veinte minutos pasar solo la verja. Tenemos que hablar, hace una hora.
Solidarity of Steel#522.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#523.src: Wow, mister loudmouth, big words for someone who wasn't supposed to be here for a few more weeks! What gives?! You're interrupting my flow!
Solidarity of Steel#523.dst: Vaya, señor bocazas, ¡qué palabras más grandes para alguien que no debía llegar hasta dentro de unas semanas! ¡¿Qué pasa?! ¡Me estás cortando el rollo!
Solidarity of Steel#523.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Solidarity of Steel#524.src: Your sche- Are you taking lessons from Oru? This provincial emergency has a much greater value than your charter, Sovereign, so I'm summing to the equatio- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#524.dst: Tu hora- ¿Estás tomando clases de Oru? Esta emergencia provincial tiene un valor mucho mayor que tu estatuto, Soberana, así que me sumo a la ecuació- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#524.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#525.src: I've changed my schedule to come here early and track down a defector- Syndra, and her set of insurgents. You've heard the name, right?
Solidarity of Steel#525.dst: He cambiado mi horario para venir antes y dar caza a una desertora- Syndra, y su grupo de insurgentes. Has oído ese nombre, ¿verdad?
Solidarity of Steel#525.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok
